courses.repertoire: Giuoco Pianissimo: c3, d3, and a slow build-up
courses.summary: Build with c3 and d3, castle, bring the queen's knight to g3, and break with d4 when ready.
Mirror White's slow setup, keep the bishop with ...a6 and ...Ba7, and know how to meet d4 and the Evans Gambit.

openings.name: Sicilian Defense
openings.summary: Black fights for d4 from the side, accepting an unbalanced game in return for winning chances.

openings.name: French Defense
openings.summary: Black builds a solid pawn chain and counterattacks White's center with ...c5 and ...f6.

openings.name: Caro-Kann Defense
openings.summary: Black supports ...d5 with the c-pawn, keeping a sound structure and an active light-squared bishop.

openings.name: Queen's Gambit
openings.summary: White offers the c-pawn to pull Black's d-pawn away from the center. Rich in plans, light on early tactics.
